title: Station Meridian Rising
author: Hazel Iversen
blurb: Silas Nakamura, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
